channel.title: Geoje on paper.archive
channel.description: Recent content in Geoje on paper.archive

item.title: Geoje Panorama Cable Car — Nojasan Observatory
item.description: Riding the Geoje Panorama Cable Car up 565m Nojasan and the view over Korea's southern archipelago, plus fares, ride time and the trails at the top.

item.title: Hanchi Mulhoe & Octopus Rice Bowl — Yoonsikdang, Geoje
item.description: Lunch on Geoje Island at Yoonsikdang: hanchi mulhoe, a cold raw-squid dish you finish with broth, and a rock-octopus rice bowl with cabbage, perilla and gim.

item.title: Dongtae-tang Breakfast on Geoje Island
item.description: Day two on Geoje Island. Breakfast at the pollack-stew place right in front of our lodging: a yellow pot of dongtae-tang kept boiling on a burner built into the table.

item.title: Geoje Haegeumgang Cruise — Between Seagulls and Cliffs
item.description: Taking the Haegeumgang sightseeing cruise off Geoje Island, where the seagulls follow the boat close enough to take snacks from your hand.

item.title: Milmyeon on Geoje Island — Woomyeonga
item.description: Chilled wheat noodles at Woomyeonga on Geoje Island. Mul-milmyeon is ₩8,500, with extra broth and spicy dadaegi on the side so you set the heat yourself.
